blighting-strike:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success:
- On a roll with Hope, deal {{proficiency|#d6+1 magic damage|d6+1 magic damage using your Proficiency}}. On a roll with Fear, deal {{proficiency|#d10+1 magic damage|d10+1 magic damage using your Proficiency}}.
- The target’s next successful attack deals half damage. On a failure, you must spend a Hope or mark a Stress.
umbral-veil:
Once per rest, mark a Stress to encase yourself in shadowy energy, placing tokens on this card equal to the Fear in the GM’s pool. After an attack roll is made against you, spend any number of tokens to give the result a −1 penalty per token spent.
At the end of the scene, clear unspent tokens.
voice-of-dread: Magically speak to a creature you can see, tormenting them. Make a Spellcast Roll against them. On a success, they mark a Stress and are frozen with terror, temporarily Restrained.
hideous-retribution: When an ally within Close range takes damage from a target you can see, make a reaction roll against the target using your Spellcast trait. On a success, mark a Stress to deal {{proficiency|#d6 magic damage|d6 magic damage using your Proficiency}}.
siphon-essence:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. Once per long rest on a success, the target takes {{proficiency|#d12+4 magic damage|d12+4 magic damage using your Proficiency}}. On a success with Fear, gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for this attack.
You clear Hit Points equal to the Hit Points the target marked from this attack.
shared-trauma: Once per rest, transfer suffering: mark any number of Hit Points on a willing creature within Melee range to clear an equal number on another willing creature within Melee range.
terrify: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress and you can make it flee one range away from you (such as Very Close to Close or Close to Far). On a success with Fear, the target also becomes temporarily Vulnerable.
chains-of-affliction: Mark 2 Stress to temporarily Chain a target within Close range. When a Chained creature deals damage, the target of their attack marks one fewer Hit Point. You can Chain only one creature at a time.
horror:
Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon an otherworldly creature that deals d8+1 magic damage using your Spellcast trait to a target within Far range. If the target marks any Hit Points, they must succeed on a Reaction Roll (12) or mark an equal number of Stress.
After the attack, the creature dissipates.
dire-strike: When a target marks Hit Points from an attack you make, spend a Hope to drain power from them; the GM loses a Fear.
spectral-mist: Spend 2 Hope to conjure an eerie mist that makes you and allies of your choice within Close range momentarily incorporeal: they can move through solid objects and are immune to physical damage. They become corporeal after passing through a solid object or making an action roll; otherwise this lasts until the end of the scene.
darkfire: Once per scene, spend any number of Hope to target that many adversaries within Close range. Each makes a Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail take d8+6 magic damage using your Spellcast trait; those who succeed take half damage.
jump-scare: When you deal magic damage to a target, mark a Stress to teleport into Melee range with them. They are Vulnerable until they mark 1 or more Hit Points.
dread-touched:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Dread domain, gain:
- When you succeed with Fear, mark 2 Stress to prevent the GM from gaining a Fear.
- Once per rest when making an action roll, gain a bonus equal to the Fear in the GM’s pool.
wall-of-hunger: Make a Spellcast Roll (10). On a success, spend a Hope to create a visible wall of writhing necrotic energy between two points within Far range. It lasts until you mark a Hit Point or cast this spell again. A creature inside the wall when it appears, or passing through it, marks 2 Stress.
dark-army:
Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, summon fiends that surround and move with you; place 8 tokens on this card. When you deal damage to a target within Very Close range, spend any number of tokens to add 1d8 per token to your damage roll. When you take damage, spend any number of tokens to reduce it by 1d8 per token. Each token spent has a fiend act on your behalf, then disappear.
When you take a rest, clear unspent tokens.
eldritch-flesh:
Gain a +1 bonus to your damage thresholds for each Stress you have marked.
When you roll with Fear, spend 2 Hope to clear an Armor Slot.
damnation: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, mark any number of Stress to roll that many d20s, dealing magic damage equal to the total result. If this defeats the target, all adversaries within Far range of it mark a Stress.
savor-the-anguish: When an adversary within Close range takes Severe damage, you can clear a Stress.
avatar-of-terror:
Mark a Stress to transform into a creature fueled by fear. In this form, gain a 1d6 bonus to damage rolls for each Fear in the GM’s pool, and gain a Hope when the GM spends a Fear to spotlight an adversary within Very Close range.
Before you make an action roll, you must spend a Hope; if you can’t, you revert to your normal form.
invoke-torment:
You deal double damage to targets with all their Stress marked.
When an adversary within Close range is defeated with all its Stress marked, gain a Hope.
